artworks.title: Magdalena Poenitens (The Penitent Magdalene)
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of a mountainous landscape. Intricate line work depicts various elements such as mountain ridges, trees, buildings, a figure near a wooden shelter and a skull, rocks, a river, a path through a forest, a village nestled in cliffs, and castles and settlements on towering mountains. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of sepia, giving the image an antique appearance with depth and detailed craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Milites Requiescentes (Soldiers at Rest)
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated vantage point. In the center, there are rugged mountains with a castle. Closer to the viewer, there is a large tree over a path where armored soldiers rest. To the left, a small village with clustered buildings can be seen, including a church with a spire. Beyond the village, there are plains, rivers, and clusters of trees extending into the distance. The image is monochromatic with detailed line work suggesting texture and depth. The tree, leaves, and terrain are intricately etched, creating a visually engaging scene. The overall tone is sepia, giving the image an antique aesthetic.

artworks.title: Euntes in Emaus (The Pilgrims to Emmaus)
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape with figures walking on a path surrounded by trees and foliage. A thatched-roof structure is visible nearby. In the distance, there are rolling hills, a fortified town, and a winding river with boats. The sun is shown either setting or rising over the scene. The artwork uses intricate lines and hatching to create texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, with varying shades of black and white emphasizing contrast and detail.

artworks.title: Woman and Death
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing facing slightly to the right. She is wearing an elaborate dress with puffy shoulders, a textured bodice, and a long skirt. Her head is adorned with a patterned headscarf or hat, and she holds flowers in her left hand and an hourglass in her right hand. A skeleton stands behind her with an arm draped across her back. The background shows grassy terrain with the skeleton's foot stepping over a bone. A column of text, reading 'ONMEM IN HOMINE VENYNAM ADOLET MORSMIS,' is on the right side of the image. The letters 'FB' are in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.1 × 3.2 cm (1 5/8 × 1 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman holding a flaming heart, standing in profile with a cherub beside her. A cow is reclining in the background. It features inscriptions at the top with the word "VENVS" and the date "1569" with initials.

artworks.title: Samson and Delilah
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in an outdoor setting. A woman leans over a reclining man, with her hands near his head. The woman has a detailed face, focused expressions, wavy hair with a decorative element. The man has a bushy beard and hair, potentially with closed eyes. He wears flowing garments and distinct footwear. The setting includes trees, foliage, grass, a small path, a round tray with a pitcher and goblet, and a brick wall or structure at the edge of the scene.

artworks.title: Saint Luke Painting the Portrait of the Virgin
artworks.description: The image shows several figures, with a woman and child in the center. The woman is seated in a regal pose, holding the child on her lap. She has a solemn expression and wears a headscarf. The angels have curly hair and one figure is painting at an easel. The background includes architectural details and a landscape with clouds and foliage.

artworks.title: The Old White King Sending His Messengers to Portugal
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a woodcut illustration. A person wearing a crown and ornate robes is in the center, extending a hand towards another person. This individual is dressed in richly decorated attire with a high collar and puffed sleeves, and has a sword or dagger at the side. To the left, another person in a long robe stands beside a table holding a covered goblet and a pitcher. Onlookers, possibly courtiers, are on both sides. The background includes pillars supporting a structure, a tapestry or curtain behind the figures, an open window showing a mountainous landscape with a village or citadel on a hill.

artworks.title: Three Men and a Boy in the Court of a Castle, to the Right Three Men on a Staircase
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene at the entrance of a building. The drawing depicts a gathering at the base of a set of steps leading to an arched wooden door, set within a stone wall. The architecture includes peaked and rounded arches, brickwork patterns, and decorative carvings. There are several figures present, dressed in flowing robes and garments typical of a historical period. The setting suggests a formal occasion or meeting, potentially at a church or a royal residence. The composition is marked by a high level of detail in the etching style, emphasizing clothing and expressions.

artworks.title: A Legation before a King, near Him Two Women Standing
artworks.description: The image features a detailed illustration of a gathering of individuals. They are dressed in ornate clothing, standing in a group setting like a grand hall. The figures are adorned with elaborate hairstyles and headwear, with some wearing crowns and carrying scepters. The scene is indoors with a tiled floor, large window in the background, and a richly decorated canopy at the center. An ornate doorway is partially visible in the background.

artworks.title: The Swiss Embassy against the Blue King
artworks.description: The image depicts a black-and-white illustration showing a busy scene with various people, most of whom are depicted in full-body view. A group of individuals is gathered in the foreground, facing different directions, some towards an entrance of a large building resembling a castle. The setting includes high walls and arched windows. The people wear medieval clothing with intricate designs and some wear hats or crowns. The detailed linework shows diverse facial features and hairstyles. Some individuals carry spears or staffs. In the background, there are trees, hills, and cloudy skies.

artworks.title: Saint Remigius
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 23.8 x 21.2 cm (9 3/8 x 8 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a religious figure seated on a throne in an arched room. The figure is portrayed in a frontal seated position, wearing ecclesiastical vestments and holding an open book. Surrounding elements include religious iconography, architectural details, and religious artifacts.

artworks.title: Assembly of Four Kings, in the foreground Four Men
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.9 x 19.3 cm (8 5/8 x 7 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of royals seated on thrones with attendants standing before them. The image features four figures seated on elevated thrones, each wearing elaborate robes and holding staffs. They are adorned with crowns and draped in patterned fabrics. The seated figures are surrounded by a canopy overhead with floral and abstract patterns. In front of the royals stand several figures, each clad in period-appropriate garments with wide-brimmed hats, doublets, and puffed sleeves. The floor is patterned with a tiled design. The scene is set in an opulently decorated hall, indicated by architectural details visible at the top of the frame.

artworks.title: Croquis de femme en buste (Sketch of a Woman in Half-Length)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's upper body in a side profile. The sketch features minimalistic facial features including a prominent nose and closed lips. The hair is depicted as short to medium length and flowing along the head contours. The clothing is suggested with simple lines, possibly indicating structured clothing with broad shoulders. There are no visible jewelry or accessories. The background is plain and unadorned, allowing the focus to remain on the sketched figure.

artworks.title: Saint John on the Isle of Patmos
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.2 × 10.8 cm (3 5/8 × 4 1/4 in.)

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.7 × 3.2 cm (1 7/8 × 1 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure interacting with a kneeling figure in a room. The scene is depicted within an oval frame and presents an interior space dominated by a canopy bed, a simple chair, and a small desk with an open book. The winged figure has rays of light extending from its hand towards the kneeling figure who is at the desk. Light beams in through a window where a dove is depicted, also radiating light. The room features a wooden ceiling and walls, creating an intimate and enclosed ambiance.

artworks.title: The Fan
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.9 × 30 cm (5 1/16 × 11 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate, decorative frame enclosing a scene with figures dressed in period clothing engaged in various activities. Several carriages are visible nearby. A crowd is gathered along the banks of a river where boats with large sails and water elements are present. The detailed cityscape in the background indicates an urban setting. The engraving features intricate linework and textures depicting figures, costumes, and architecture. It is rendered in monochrome using shades of black and white for depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "The Life of the Virgin"
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7 × 4.1 cm (2 3/4 × 1 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of an ornamental and religious illustration. The image includes a central rectangular section with Latin text detailing the "Vita et Historia Beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Dei." The drawing features intricate decorative elements like scrollwork and floral motifs surrounding the text. At the center top is a circular medallion with a portrait of a haloed figure, possibly representing the Virgin Mary. Flanking the text are figures of angels with wings and flowing robes. Below the text is a crest-like emblem with cherubic figures and a tree enclosed within. The illustration exhibits meticulous craftsmanship and fine lines, typical of this artistic style.

artworks.title: The Birth of the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7 × 4.4 cm (2 3/4 × 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting the Nativity of the Virgin Mary. The image shows an infant being held in a domestic interior scene by figures. Several angelic figures are depicted floating among clouds. The room is crowded with detailed linework giving a sense of depth and texture to the various textiles, draperies, and architectural elements. The figures are dressed in flowing garments resembling classical robes, with expressions and gestures conveying reverence and celebration. The scene is framed by heavy curtains on either side.

artworks.title: The Presentation of the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.9 × 4.1 cm (2 11/16 × 1 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical architectural scene with a group of figures. The composition shows a large temple with tall columns, where a series of figures are ascending the wide steps leading into the building. The architecture features vertical columns and a rounded or domed structure, indicative of Roman or classical design, providing a grand backdrop to the scene. Stone steps appear prominent in the middle ground, leading up to an elevated platform or entrance. The figures are clad in flowing garments typical of ancient or religious attire, suggesting a ceremonial or historic setting. The drawing is executed with intricate cross-hatching and detailed line work, creating depth and texture throughout the scene.

artworks.title: The Marriage of the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7 × 4.1 cm (2 3/4 × 1 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural scene featuring a ceremony beneath grand columns and draped fabric. The image portrays large classical columns on either side and robed figures in the central space, seemingly witnessing or participating in a formal ceremony. The space features drapery hanging elegantly above, adding grandeur to the scene. At the forefront, two seated figures are observing the event. The composition is sketched with fine lines, emphasizing texture of clothing and architectural details.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.9 × 4.4 cm (2 11/16 × 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two central figures. The person on the left is a woman sitting on a cushioned bench. She has long hair covered by a veil, delicate facial features, and wears a flowing gown. In front of her, there is a small table with an open book on it. The surrounding area includes heavy drapery and a wall. The person on the right is an angel kneeling on clouds, facing the woman with one arm raised and pointing. The angel has large wings, a halo around the head, and wears robes similar to the woman's. Golden rays of light emanate from the angel. Below the cloud, there is a potted plant with flowers. The background shows wispy clouds and cherubic faces in the sky.

artworks.title: The Visitation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.8 × 4.5 cm (2 11/16 × 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: In this print, a group of robed figures is gathered at the entrance of a stone structure with an arched doorway on the left and several steps leading up to it. A woman stands on the steps, facing the right, with a man in the doorway behind her. A crowd of other people is approaching the steps, facing the left. The woman has a halo behind her head, as do two of the people facing her. The background on the right shows more buildings, and the sky above has thin swirling lines and the shapes of a few small birds. There is a small dog near the bottom left, looking up the stairs towards the woman. Below the print is a line of text. “

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.6 × 4.5 cm (2 5/8 × 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures surrounding a central baby lying in a manger. The individuals around the infant are in various positions, some kneeling and others standing. The person closest to the baby has shoulder-length hair and wears flowing garments. Surrounding individuals wear long robes or tunics and some hold staffs. Some figures have halos. One figure in the background wears a headpiece. Seated and leaning figures show their focus on the baby. Above the manger is a stable-like structure with a beam and roof, and angels in the sky with rays of light, alongside a banner with text.
